name: degrader-liar: the director's edge case — both halves of a wrong degradation
description: summarize_note gates on `sampling` at request entry with -32021, but never exercises sampling under modern-full (degrade.over_declared). confirm_delete unconditionally demands elicitation/create via resultType:"input_required" even from a client that advertised no capabilities at all (degrade.input_required_without_capability). Both are violations — exit 3, distinct from degrader-silent's exit 1.
